title: •So This Is How Liberty Dies
caption: •Vote Now! (Light) (V)
heading: •So This Is How Liberty Dies (V)
game_text_lines:
Deploy on Senate. Your {set:coruscant} Political Effects are lost.
While you have a character here with *rebellion
agenda*, your Force drains at battlegrounds where
you have a Rebel are +1 and may not be canceled.
May not be canceled or placed in Used Pile.

notes: Group: Rebel Senate. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1099) that turns a USED INTERRUPT into a POLITICAL EFFECT: red frame; title bar with a GREEN swirl disc (the Effect type disc) where the printed Vote Now! has the red Interrupt disc; title '•So This Is How Liberty Dies'; destiny 3 (printed 5). LORE PRINTED ON THE SLIP: “Vote now! Vote now! Vote now!” with DOUBLE curly quotes (printed card: single ‘…’; same words) → lore = slip's, base_lore = printed. Right of the lore box: ONLY the EPISODE I disc — no Coruscant ring on the slip (VB5 reissue the same) → ring_icons ['episode1']. Art blank. Banner POLITICAL EFFECT (printed USED INTERRUPT); no stats, no deploy/forfeit, no column icons; VS16 sphere in the bottom-right corner. Inline pink Coruscant set symbol before 'Political Effects' ({set:coruscant}). 'rebellion agenda' BOLD (spans the line break). Caption on the strip '•Vote Now! (Light) (V)' — '(Light)' is the sheet's side disambiguation; base_title '•Vote Now!' as printed; wiki base page 'Vote Now!' (no '(Light)' page exists). Slip text matches the stub. Base scan 350 px; Coruscant 2001 line by rule (not legible). Modern: VB5-L-sothisishowlibertydies-pre.gif (350).
